nodes.description: Boolean flag controlling whether the reward/burn game logic runs during transfers
Address of the ETH-X20 Uniswap liquidity pool; transfers originating here can win the game
Incrementing nonce mixed into the pseudo-random keccak256 computation
First secret seed set once by startGame and used by _play/_randModulus
Second seed derived from _randModulus at startGame; used by burn rate and _play
Win chance rate variable set to 100 in startGame (never actually used in the math)
onlyOwner initializer that sets liquidityPool, seeds, chanceRate and flips gameStarted to true
Overridden ERC20 transfer that routes the amount through _getAmount before the base transfer
Overridden ERC20 transferFrom that routes the amount through _getAmount before the base transferFrom
Private hook that triggers the reward/burn game when gameStarted and returns the adjusted amount
Private function that mints a 10x reward when the sender is the liquidity pool and _play wins
Private function computing the 1%-10% deflationary burn amount from seed2
Public pseudo-random draw comparing two _randModulus values seeded by seed1/seed2
Private PRNG returning keccak256(nonce, seed, now, block.difficulty, msg.sender) % mod and bumping nonce
Inherited ERC20 _mint that increases _totalSupply and the recipient balance
Inherited ERC20 _burn that decreases sender balance and _totalSupply
Caller-controlled address used as sender, as pool comparison value and as PRNG entropy
now / block.timestamp used as entropy inside _randModulus, making randomness miner-influenced
_mint(recipient, amount.mul(10)) awards unbacked 10x tokens based on a predictable PRNG outcome
_burn(sender, burnAmount) destroys part of the sender balance based on a predictable random burn rate
keccak256 over nonce, seed, now, block.difficulty and msg.sender: predictable/attacker-influenceable randomness
startGame argument holding the Uniswap pool address
startGame argument assigned to the seed1 state variable
transfer/transferFrom recipient argument passed down into _getAmount and the reward mint
transfer/transferFrom amount argument, later possibly multiplied by 10 or reduced by burn
_getAmount local holding the computed burn amount before subtraction
_randModulus local holding the keccak256 modulo result
_randModulus modulus argument (90, 100 or 10000000)
_randModulus seed argument (seed1 or seed2)

edges.reason: transfer delegates amount adjustment to _getAmount before calling the base ERC20 transfer
transferFrom delegates amount adjustment to _getAmount before calling the base ERC20 transferFrom
_getAmount invokes _sendReward when the game is active
_getAmount invokes _getRandomBurnedAmount to compute the deflationary burn
_sendReward calls _play to decide whether the reward is won
_sendReward executes the unsafe reward mint operation when the PRNG draw wins
_getRandomBurnedAmount derives the burn rate via _randModulus
_play calls _randModulus twice for its two PRNG draws
_randModulus performs the keccak256-based pseudo-random operation
_getAmount executes the unsafe burn operation when burnAmount is non-zero
the burn operation invokes ERC20 _burn
the reward mint operation invokes ERC20 _mint
msg.sender is forwarded as the sender argument into _getAmount, where it decides whether the game is played
msg.sender is compared with liquidityPool in _sendReward to authorise the reward path
liquidityPool state is compared against the caller to gate reward minting
block.timestamp (now) is fed into the randomness computation, creating timestamp dependency
msg.sender is used as entropy in the PRNG, letting the caller influence the random outcome
nonce is packed into the keccak256 randomness input
seed1 state variable is passed as the seed argument to _randModulus
seed2 state variable is passed as the seed argument to _randModulus
_randModulus reads and increments the nonce state variable
startGame writes gameStarted to true, enabling the game logic in transfers
startGame writes the liquidity pool address
startGame stores seed1
startGame stores the derived seed2
startGame sets chanceRate to 100
_getAmount reads gameStarted to decide whether to run the reward/burn logic
_play uses seed1 as the seed for its first PRNG draw
_play uses seed2 as the seed for its second PRNG draw
_getRandomBurnedAmount uses seed2 to derive the burn rate
the random burn amount is stored in the local burnAmount variable
the local burnAmount is passed into the unsafe burn operation
the user-supplied amount is passed into _getAmount
amount is multiplied by 10 inside the reward mint, an unchecked value amplification
the recipient argument receives the minted reward tokens
the recipient argument is forwarded into _getAmount and later to the reward mint
the _liquidityPool parameter is written into the liquidityPool state variable
the _seed1 parameter is written into the seed1 state variable
the PRNG result is stored in the local rand variable returned by _randModulus
the mod parameter is the modulus applied to the keccak256 result
the seed parameter is packed into the keccak256 randomness input

normalization_plan.reason: The parameter only exists to be stored into the liquidityPool state variable inside startGame
The parameter only exists to seed seed1/seed2 inside startGame
The recipient argument flows from transfer/transferFrom into _getAmount and the reward mint
The amount argument is the value routed through _getAmount, the burn and the reward mint
The local only holds the value consumed by the burn operation
The local only holds the modulo result of the unsafe keccak256 PRNG
The modulus parameter is used solely to bound the pseudo-random value in _randModulus
The seed parameter is used solely as keccak256 entropy inside _randModulus
